description: A phased development comprising demolition of existing buildings on Site and the construction of three blocks at 4 storeys, 11 storeys and 12 storeys providing 176 residential units (Use Class C3) with associated affordable housing provision along with delivery of wider public realm improvements comprising hard and soft landscaping and other associated works  (Application site affects the settings of Grade II Listed Buildings).
site_name: Land At 10 To 11 Brunel Street And 36 To 48
